correctness.rationale: On six points, the Tutte–Coxeter graph has fifteen duads, fifteen synthemes and 45 incident flags. For each selected duad set S, a chosen private syntheme for every selected duad must intersect S only there, so the weighted product count over all 32768 subsets is a true bijection. The polynomial spectrum has coefficients 1,45,720,5160,16920,22680,8520,720,90,10 and sum 54866. For |S|>=10, the complement K6-edge set has <=5 edges and insufficient disjoint edge pairs for the mandatory injection. Equality |S|=9 forces six complement edges and every degree two; C6 fails an onto-private-syntheme test, leaving a union of two triangles and exactly ten 3+3 cross-edge maxima. Distinct 3+3 partitions share at most five flags, so their 90 single-edge deletions are distinct, exhaust coefficient z8=90 and each extends uniquely. Independent original 45-flag conflict enumeration matches the separate 32768-subset product spectrum, size-eight extensions and inclusion-maximal multiplicities 3060,5520,360,10.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge: the classical generalized quadrangle duad–syntheme model and strong matchings are known. Published Tutte–Coxeter independence-complex work concerns vertex-independent sets, not matchings. No inspected source covers the exact induced matching spectrum, ten 3+3 maxima and unique size-eight completion law.
